title: Examining Untempered Social Media: Analyzing Cascades of Polarized Conversations
reasoning: The paper focuses on social network analysis, specifically modeling the propagation of conversations on Gab. While it uses religious identity groups (e.g., Anti-Semitism, Anti-Islam) as labels for the polarized content it analyzes, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, theology, or ethical systems themselves, nor does it study these within the context of AI models.
